theme.title: NBA Mix 64
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: In the deciding Game 5 of the 2002 first round against Philadelphia, Paul Pierce scored how many points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Paul Pierce led the way with 46, on 8-10 shooting from downtown

funFacts.text: Boston had reached the playoffs for the first time in seven years before meeting Philadelphia.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: This series marked the return of the Celtics to the playoffs for the first time in seven years

funFacts.text: The 76ers came into the matchup as defending Eastern Conference champions behind Allen Iverson.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they faced the reigning Eastern Conference champion in the first round

funFacts.text: Antoine Walker shared the scoring burden during the series and helped Boston turn back Philadelphia's rally.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: In his first Bucks season, about how many assists per game did Oscar Robertson average, to the nearest whole number?
questions.note: About 8: the text says 8.3, the season table 8.25.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Robertson ranked third in the league in assists at 8.3 apg and was the Bucks' No. 2 scorer at 19.4 ppg.
source.derivation: The article’s text says 8.3; its season table gives 668 assists in 81 games, 8.25. Either way, 8 to the nearest whole number.

funFacts.text: Robertson also scored 19.4 points per game while partnering Alcindor.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bucks' No. 2 scorer at 19.4 ppg

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
